ctx.x: Yeah. Ivy, Verne and Vonne. And after Floyd Ray had broken up, as I say, I guess around '45 or something, then my cousin, we called Bunch, Ivy, she got a bass fiddle and started playing it. And they formed a little trio. One of them played the drums, or guitar, or something, and one played the piano, and Bunch played the bass. And they
were very successful. They made a couple of movies, you know, played the bits in a couple of movies, like that.
